provenance_evidence.source_pt: float-big.pt, the Ball Leveler big-ball checkpoint named by the Slice-2 export record (denso-artifacts model-mode-compatibility/slice3-ce3ff73/provenance/float-big.provenance.json, key source_pt)
provenance_evidence.source_pt_sha256: measured from the checkpoint at export time and recorded in the Slice-2 export record (float-big.provenance.json, key source_pt_sha256)
provenance_evidence.onnx: float-big.onnx, the artifact the approved trtexec recipe in packaging/models.approved compiles
provenance_evidence.onnx_sha256: measured from float-big.onnx by the Slice-2 exporter (float-big.provenance.json, key onnx_sha256); the Slice-3 build report records the same value as the ONNX it compiled (slice3-engine-build.json entry float-big.engine, key source_onnx_sha256), so the two records describe one artifact chain
provenance_evidence.onnx_opset: measured from the ONNX: actual_onnx_opset = 13 AND actual_onnx_opset_from_args_metadata = 13; opset 13 was requested and Ultralytics kept it (unlike digitv3, which was downgraded to 12)
provenance_evidence.export_ultralytics: float-big.onnx metadata `version` = 8.4.21 (float-big.provenance.json, key export_ultralytics). It differs from float-small's 8.4.33 because this checkpoint was exported on its own training version; the record sets controlled_deviation = false, so no approved deviation was invoked.
provenance_evidence.precision: the approved trtexec recipe in packaging/models.approved uses --fp16; the Slice-3 build report records the same flag in exact_trtexec_command for this engine
provenance_evidence.jetpack: INFERENCE, labelled as such: the nvidia-jetpack meta-package is NOT installed on 192.168.1.15; L4T R36.5.0 was measured on the device during the Slice-3 engine build (slice3-engine-build.json, key l4t_version) and is the supported baseline in AGENTS.md/build_package.sh. Same treatment as digitv3.
provenance_evidence.export_onnx_command: the export call recorded verbatim by the Slice-2 exporter (float-big.provenance.json, key export_command)
provenance_evidence.export_engine_command: verbatim from the float-big line of packaging/models.approved; slice3-engine-build.json entry float-big.engine records exact_trtexec_command as /usr/src/tensorrt/bin/trtexec with these same arguments (cwd the models directory) and build_exit_code 0
